title: Customer logs in with email and password

card.i_want: to log in with my email and password
card.so_that: I can access my profile, cart and orders securely

context: Authentication boundary for the storefront; credentials are PII under PDPA and the failure message must not enable account enumeration.

given: a registered customer with valid credentials
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer submits a login request
then: a 15-minute access token and a 14-day refresh token are issued
no password or token value appears in any log

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: wrong password is indistinguishable from unknown email
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer submits a wrong password
then: the request is rejected with the generic message 'email or password is incorrect'
the same message is returned for an unknown email
an audit event is emitted carrying {event, actor, ts, outcome, audit_id} with no credential value

pii_fields.justification: email and phone are direct PII; password is a credential
pii_fields.treatment: encrypt at rest; one-way hash for password; redact in logs

audit_events.justification: login attempts must be auditable for security review

idempotency.justification: login is an authn read with no state mutation to replay

reversibility.justification: issuing a session has nothing to reverse

authn_authz.justification: this story is the authentication boundary itself

regulatory.justification: PDPA B.E. 2562 sec. 24 lawful basis for credential handling; citation resolved

tipping_off.justification: no SAR/AML context in an e-commerce login
